messages.content: What is my roll number?
I don't know your roll number, as I can't see your school records. It is usually on your ID card or report card.
Cup of tea at the stall by the school gate, what is the price?
I don't know the stall's price. Just ask the seller, as it can change from week to week.
How many degrees will it be in Mysuru at noon tomorrow?
I don't know the temperature in Mysuru at noon tomorrow, as I can't check forecasts. A weather service for Mysuru will give it.
What is the password I set for my study app?
I never see your passwords, so I don't know it. The app's reset option can help you set a new one.
Did the new telescope send its first pictures back?
I'm not sure if the telescope has sent its first pictures, as I can't see recent announcements. The space agency's official page posts new images as they arrive.
How many copies of the school magazine were printed in the first year?
I don't know how many copies were printed, as I have no printing record. Ask the staff who run the magazine, or check old issues in the office.
Has the lead singer of the band cancelled tonight's show?
I'm not sure if the show is cancelled, as I get no updates from the venue. The band's page or the ticket office will have the latest.
Is Luca's family planning a trip this summer?
I don't know if Luca's family is planning a trip, as I can't see their plans. Ask Luca, or wait to see if he mentions it.
What did Grandpa tell me last summer about his village?
I don't know what he said, because I wasn't part of that talk. Ask your grandfather again, and perhaps write down what he says.
Did the singing contest on TV last weekend end with a surprise?
I'm not sure what happened, because I can't look up recent shows. A friend who watched it, or the channel's own page, can tell you.
What was my dream last night about?
I don't know, as dreams stay in your own head. Write it down when you wake up if you like remembering them.
How many grams of cardamom did the first recipe for this sweet use?
I don't know, because I can't check an unknown first recipe. A trusted cookbook from the region may say how it was made.
How many steps are there up to the hilltop fort?
I don't know, because step counts are a very specific detail. The fort's ticket counter or a local guide could give an answer.
What time does my shift start tomorrow?
I can't tell when your shift starts, because I can't see your schedule. Check the roster at your workplace or message your supervisor.
Is there a boat to the temple island on Sundays?
I don't have the Sunday trips, because a ferry's timetable is set by its operator and changes. The ferry office or the jetty notice will list them.
What is the latest on the film festival lineup?
I don't know the latest lineup. The festival's official page will list the films.
Till when is the library open today?
I'm not sure of today's hours. A notice at the library or its page will say.
How hot will it be in Kolkata on Diwali day?
I can't see a forecast that far ahead. A weather service for Kolkata will show it closer to the day.
What are today's vegetable prices in the main market?
I don't have today's rates. The market's price board or a seller will tell you.
What song was stuck in my head when I woke up?
I have no way to know. What runs through your head stays with you. Humming the tune to a friend might help you find its name.
